seo.title: Infinite Playlist Tour: BEATROX Festival Activation
seo.description: Beatrox produced the Amazon Music Live Infinite Playlist Tour activations at Outside Lands 2023 and Stagecoach 2023: immersive festival builds with AR moments, interactive touchpoints, and artist meet & greets.

og.title: Infinite Playlist Tour: Amazon Music Live
og.description: Beatrox produced immersive festival activations for Amazon Music Live at Outside Lands and Stagecoach 2023: AR moments, custom murals, and exclusive artist meet & greets.

hero.headline: Infinite Playlist Tour
hero.subheadline: Two unforgettable festival activations for Amazon Music Live, bringing fans unprecedented access to artists at Outside Lands and Stagecoach 2023.

locations: Outside Lands Music Festival 2023, San Francisco, CA
metadata.type: Interactive Media Experience, Event Production, Festival Activation
techniques: AR Moments with Free-Standing LED Walls

body.heading: Design Objective
body.content: Amazon Music aimed to create an unforgettable festival experience that would break through the clutter and delight audiences at select 2023 music festivals. The objective was to provide fans with unprecedented access to the music and artists they love, while also engaging them with interactive elements that enhance their overall festival experience.

body.heading: Outside Lands, San Francisco
body.content: At Outside Lands, the experience featured a reflective exterior and a custom mural by Bay Area artist Chaz Bear. Fans passed through a colorful, Astera-lit hallway into a music-filled space that took over the 3-day festival. The space included meet & greet sessions with artists and interviews hosted by Bimma Williams, enhancing fan engagement throughout the weekend.

body.heading: Stagecoach, Indio, CA
body.content: At Stagecoach, attendees enjoyed the official festival livestream in a striking, technicolor build with interactive touchpoints throughout the space, including exclusive merch giveaways, artist meet & greets, VIP pass giveaways, and an Amazon Music LIVE photobooth.

body.heading: Key Features
items: Reflective exterior build with custom Bay Area artist mural (Chaz Bear)
Artist meet & greet sessions hosted by Bimma Williams
AR moments powered by free-standing LED walls and Kinect Azure
Interactive touchpoints: merch giveaways, VIP pass activations, photobooth
Multi-festival deployment with custom builds per venue
